publisher: The Tonight Show Starring Jimmy Fallon
label: 影片 25
theme: Anne Hathaway 談好勝心、浣熊搶戲與《The Idea of You》
themeEn: Anne Hathaway Forgets The Princess Diaries and The Devil Wears Prada Details

ex.en: You're a great partner. -I mean, are you are you competitive when you play games?
ex.zh: 你是很棒的搭檔。－我是說，你玩遊戲的時候好勝心強嗎？

tips.t: competitive price 有競爭力的價格；competitive salary 優渥的薪資（徵才廣告必考）。

ex.en: Yeah. -I think maybe being competitive is genetic, because my kids are, like -- They're competitive, too.
ex.zh: 對。－我覺得好勝心可能是遺傳的，因為我的孩子們……他們也很好勝。

ex.en: You know movies. -I didn't -- I mean, apparently, I do.
ex.zh: 你很懂電影。－我沒有……我是說，顯然我懂。

tips.t: Apparently, the meeting was canceled. 聽說會議取消了（口語常表示「聽說」）。

ex.en: So, uh, junior executive assistant, 'Devil Wears Prada.'" I'm just like, "Emily Blunt."
ex.zh: 所以，呃，《穿著 Prada 的惡魔》裡的初級執行助理。」我就說：「Emily Blunt。」

tips.t: executive assistant 執行助理；chief executive officer（CEO）執行長。

ex.en: I was gonna say, "Wait..." -But I was genuinely confused.
ex.zh: 我正要說：「等一下……」－但我是真的搞混了。

tips.t: genuine leather 真皮；genuinely interested 真心感興趣。

ex.en: Yeah, they love you so much. -I love that it's become kind of one of those family touchstones.
ex.zh: 對，她們超愛你的。－我很喜歡它變成那種全家人共同的經典回憶。

tips.t: a family touchstone 全家人共同的經典回憶。

pos.m: 首次登台，首演；（產品）首次亮相

ex.en: You made your kind of Broadway debut together in "Gutenberg! The Musical!"
ex.zh: 你們一起在《Gutenberg! The Musical!》裡算是完成了百老匯首演。

tips.t: make one's Broadway debut 百老匯首演；the product will debut next month 產品下個月首度亮相。

pos.m: 代表人物，偶像；（電腦）圖示

ex.en: She's also a New York icon. -Oh, yeah. -So I think if she shows up at a pizzeria -- -Yeah, she's a New York icon.
ex.zh: 她也是紐約的代表人物。－喔，對。－所以我覺得如果她出現在一家披薩店……－對，她是紐約的代表人物。

tips.t: click the icon 點擊圖示（操作說明）；a fashion icon 時尚偶像。

ex.en: and I'm very -- I'm just very grateful for our relationship. -She's so cool. -She's so cool. -She's so cool. -So cool. -Do you get nervous around -- I get a little nervous -- -I absolutely do. -You do?
ex.zh: 我非常……我真的非常感謝我們之間的關係。－她好酷。－她好酷。－她好酷。－超酷。－你在她身邊會緊張嗎？我會有點緊張……－我絕對會。－你會？

tips.t: I would be grateful if you could... 若您能～將不勝感激（正式書信必考）。

ex.en: Thank goodness. -No, you were perfect. -Well, because -- So, the Delacorte Theater is an outdoor theater in Central Park.
ex.zh: 謝天謝地。－沒有，你很完美。－嗯，因為……Delacorte 劇場是中央公園裡的一座露天劇場。

tips.t: outdoor seating 戶外座位（餐廳）；outdoor adj. vs. outdoors adv.（Part 5 詞性題）。

pos.m: 預告片；拖車，（片場）休息車

ex.en: The trailer alone has gotten over 125 million views. -Yeah. -It crushed, broke the record.
ex.zh: 光是預告片觀看次數就超過 1 億 2500 萬次。－對。－大獲成功，打破紀錄。

tips.t: movie trailer 電影預告；本片的 trailer 同時指預告片和明星休息車。

ex.en: Because you're just a mom and you're chaperoning this thing and you go to this thing and then you see this boy band. -I love hearing you describe my movie.
ex.zh: 因為你只是個媽媽，負責陪同這個活動，你去了這個活動，然後看到這個男子團體。－我好喜歡聽你描述我的電影。

tips.t: chaperone a school trip 帶隊校外教學。

ex.en: Mom is chaperoning, like, a Coachella type of thing, like a giant outdoor festival thing, and the biggest boy band in the world, and then the lead singer -- -Oh, yes, so, my daughter is off watching St.
ex.zh: 媽媽在陪同，像是一個類似 Coachella 的活動，一個大型戶外音樂節，然後有全世界最紅的男子團體，然後主唱……－喔，對，所以我女兒跑去看 St.

tips.t: music festival 音樂節；film festival 影展（Part 4 活動公告）。

ex.en: And the rest is -- High jinks ensues.
ex.zh: 接下來就……一連串爆笑的事發生了。

tips.t: high jinks ensue 接著一連串爆笑場面；the ensuing discussion 隨後的討論。

ex.en: "The Idea of You" begins streaming on Prime Video this Thursday.
ex.zh: 《The Idea of You》本週四在 Prime Video 上線。

tips.t: begin streaming on 在某平台上線；streaming service 串流服務。
